caption:
Every trade has that one moment the phone always picks to ring.
Miss it and the caller can end up with whoever answered first.
TradeReach texts every missed caller back within moments, asks what they need and sends you a clear job summary, so you call back ready.
👉 See how it works at tradereach.net
Which one's you? Tell us in the comments.
#australiantradies #tradiebusiness #smallbusinessaustralia #tradielife

scenes.text:
The phone always rings
at the *worst* moment
scenes.body: Swipe and tag a mate who's been there.
Nobody's reaching for a phone there. Nor should they.
Wet hands, slippery phone, caller gives up after five rings.

scenes.text:
Head in the *ceiling.*
Ducting in both hands.
scenes.body: Phone's on the ladder below. It rings. Then it stops.

scenes.text:
Gate hinge in one hand.
Drill in the *other.*
scenes.body: By the time it's hung, the caller might be ringing someone else.

scenes.text:
Whichever one's you,
they get a *text back.*
scenes.body: It asks what they need and sends you one job summary. Emergencies get flagged straight away.
